reply.emotion: craving something sweet after a long day, cozy and indulgent
notes: In Mexico and many Spanish-speaking countries, 'chocolate' can also refer to a traditional hot chocolate drink prepared with water or milk, often spiced with cinnamon.

senses.definition: Alimento dulce hecho con cacao y azúcar, que suele tener forma de tableta.

examples.text: Me gusta comer un poco de chocolate después de cenar.
examples.translation: I like to eat a little bit of chocolate after dinner.
examples.emotion: relaxed and happy, enjoying a quiet evening treat

senses.definition: Bebida caliente o fría hecha con cacao y leche o agua.

examples.text: En invierno siempre tomo un chocolate caliente por la mañana.
examples.translation: In winter I always have a hot chocolate in the morning.
examples.emotion: warm and comforted against the morning cold
